Panduan & Kode Server Google Apps Script (Code.gs & Index.html)

Buka Google Sheets → Extensions → Apps Script → Tempel Code.gs & buat file HTML Index → Deploy Web App (Anyone)

Langkah Online Permanen (Dapat Diakses dari HP/Laptop Mana Saja):
  1. Klik Salin Code.gs lalu tempelkan ke file Code.gs di editor Google Apps Script Anda.
  2. Klik ikon + di samping Files → pilih HTML → beri nama Index → klik Salin Index.html lalu tempelkan ke dalamnya.
  3. Klik Deploy → New deployment → Web app → atur Execute as: Me dan Who has access: Anyone → salin link /exec.
// ============================================================================
// BACKEND GOOGLE APPS SCRIPT - ABSENSI DIGITAL UPTD SMPN 2 KETAPANG
// 9 Tab Otomatis: Data_Pengguna, Data_Siswa, Data_Kelas_Guru, Absensi_Masuk,
// Absensi_Pulang, Pengajuan_Izin, Log_WA, Pengaturan_Sistem, Log_Aktivitas
// ============================================================================

const SHEET_SCHEMAS = {
  'Data_Pengguna': ['username', 'password', 'name', 'role', 'roleLabel'],
  'Data_Siswa': ['id', 'nis', 'nisn', 'nama', 'jk', 'kelas', 'ortu', 'wa', 'alamat', 'kode_qr'],
  'Data_Kelas_Guru': ['name', 'level', 'wali'],
  'Absensi_Masuk': ['id', 'date', 'nisn', 'nama', 'kelas', 'jam_masuk', 'status', 'wa_status'],
  'Absensi_Pulang': ['id', 'date', 'nisn', 'nama', 'kelas', 'jam_pulang', 'wa_status'],
  'Pengajuan_Izin': ['id', 'studentId', 'nisn', 'nama', 'kelas', 'date', 'type', 'reason', 'status'],
  'Log_WA': ['id', 'time', 'student', 'phone', 'type', 'message', 'status'],
  'Pengaturan_Sistem': ['key', 'value'],
  'Log_Aktivitas': ['waktu', 'aksi', 'detail', 'status']
};

const SPREADSHEET_ID = '18wmmQKyTwLWlOQwsGAZDBySoElPyhhAmOpp_WbOUvHE';
function getDatabaseSpreadsheet() {
  return SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet() || SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
}

function doGet(e) {
  const ss = getDatabaseSpreadsheet();
  initSheets(ss);

  // Jika dipanggil dengan parameter ?action=pull, kembalikan JSON database (mendukung JSONP callback)
  if (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.action === 'pull') {
    const data = pullAllData();
    if (e.parameter.callback) {
      return ContentService.createTextOutput(e.parameter.callback + '(' + JSON.stringify(data) + ')')
        .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JAVASCRIPT);
    }
    return jsonResponse(data);
  }

  // Jika dibuka langsung di browser sebagai Web App, tampilkan file HTML 'Index'
  try {
    return HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('Index')
      .setTitle('SISTEM INFORMASI ABSENSI DIGITAL SISWA - UPTD SMPN 2 KETAPANG')
      .setXFrameOptionsMode(HtmlService.XFrameOptionsMode.ALLOWALL)
      .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse({ status: 'ok', message: 'API Backend Aktif. Buat file HTML bernama Index untuk antarmuka langsung.' });
  }
}

function doPost(e) {
  try {
    const raw = (e && e.parameter && e.parameter.payload) ? e.parameter.payload : (e && e.postData ? e.postData.contents : '{}');
    const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
    return jsonResponse(processSyncPayload(payload));
  } catch (err) {
    return jsonResponse({ status: 'error', message: err.toString() });
  }
}

// Dipanggil langsung oleh google.script.run dari browser
function serverSyncAction(payload) {
  return processSyncPayload(payload);
}

function pullAllData() {
  const ss = getDatabaseSpreadsheet();
  initSheets(ss);

  const masukList = sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Masuk'));
  const pulangList = sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Pulang'));
  const pulangMap = {};
  pulangList.forEach(p => { pulangMap[p.date + '_' + p.nisn] = p.jam_pulang; });

  const mergedAttendance = masukList.map(m => ({
    id: m.id,
    date: m.date,
    nisn: m.nisn,
    nama: m.nama,
    kelas: m.kelas,
    jam_masuk: m.jam_masuk,
    jam_pulang: pulangMap[m.date + '_' + m.nisn] || '',
    status: m.status,
    wa_status: m.wa_status
  }));

  const setRows = sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Pengaturan_Sistem'));
  const settingsObj = {};
  setRows.forEach(r => { if (r.key) settingsObj[r.key] = r.value; });

  return {
    status: 'success',
    users: sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Pengguna')),
    students: sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Siswa')),
    classes: sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Kelas_Guru')),
    attendance: mergedAttendance,
    leaves: sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Pengajuan_Izin')),
    waLogs: sheetToObjects(ss.getSheetByName('Log_WA')),
    settings: settingsObj
  };
}

function processSyncPayload(payload) {
  const ss = getDatabaseSpreadsheet();
  initSheets(ss);
  const action = payload.action;

  if (action === 'record_attendance') {
    const d = payload.data;
    if (d.jam_masuk && d.jam_masuk !== '-') {
      upsertRow(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Masuk'), 'id', [
        d.id, d.date, d.nisn, d.nama, d.kelas, d.jam_masuk, d.status, d.wa_status || 'Terkirim'
      ]);
    }
    if (d.jam_pulang && d.jam_pulang !== '-') {
      upsertRow(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Pulang'), 'id', [
        'PLG-' + d.date + '-' + d.nisn, d.date, d.nisn, d.nama, d.kelas, d.jam_pulang, d.wa_status || 'Terkirim'
      ]);
    }
    logActivity(ss, 'SCAN_' + (d.jam_pulang ? 'PULANG' : 'MASUK'), d.nama + ' (' + d.kelas + ') - ' + d.status, 'OK');

    let waDeliveryStatus = 'Antrean';
    if (payload.wa && payload.wa.phone) {
      const waResult = sendWhatsAppGateway(payload.wa, ss);
      waDeliveryStatus = waResult.statusText;
      ss.getSheetByName('Log_WA').appendRow([
        'WA-' + new Date().getTime(),
        d.date + ' ' + (d.jam_pulang || d.jam_masuk || ''),
        d.nama,
        payload.wa.phone,
        d.jam_pulang ? 'PULANG' : d.status,
        payload.wa.message || '',
        waDeliveryStatus
      ]);
      if (d.jam_masuk && d.jam_masuk !== '-') {
        upsertRow(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Masuk'), 'id', [
          d.id, d.date, d.nisn, d.nama, d.kelas, d.jam_masuk, d.status, waDeliveryStatus
        ]);
      }
      if (d.jam_pulang && d.jam_pulang !== '-') {
        upsertRow(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Pulang'), 'id', [
          'PLG-' + d.date + '-' + d.nisn, d.date, d.nisn, d.nama, d.kelas, d.jam_pulang, waDeliveryStatus
        ]);
      }
    }
    return { status: 'success', waStatus: waDeliveryStatus, message: 'Absensi & WhatsApp diproses otomatis' };
  }

  if (action === 'sync_all') {
    if (payload.users) overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Pengguna'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Data_Pengguna'], payload.users);
    if (payload.students) overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Siswa'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Data_Siswa'], payload.students);
    if (payload.classes) overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Data_Kelas_Guru'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Data_Kelas_Guru'], payload.classes);
    if (payload.leaves) overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Pengajuan_Izin'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Pengajuan_Izin'], payload.leaves);
    if (payload.waLogs) overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Log_WA'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Log_WA'], payload.waLogs);
    if (payload.attendance) {
      const masukRows = payload.attendance.map(a => ({
        id: a.id, date: a.date, nisn: a.nisn, nama: a.nama, kelas: a.kelas,
        jam_masuk: a.jam_masuk || '-', status: a.status, wa_status: a.wa_status || '-'
      }));
      const pulangRows = payload.attendance.filter(a => a.jam_pulang && a.jam_pulang !== '-').map(a => ({
        id: 'PLG-' + a.date + '-' + a.nisn, date: a.date, nisn: a.nisn, nama: a.nama,
        kelas: a.kelas, jam_pulang: a.jam_pulang, wa_status: a.wa_status || 'Terkirim'
      }));
      overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Masuk'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Absensi_Masuk'], masukRows);
      overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Absensi_Pulang'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Absensi_Pulang'], pulangRows);
    }
    if (payload.settings) {
      const setRows = Object.keys(payload.settings).map(k => ({ key: k, value: String(payload.settings[k]) }));
      overwriteSheet(ss.getSheetByName('Pengaturan_Sistem'), SHEET_SCHEMAS['Pengaturan_Sistem'], setRows);
    }
    logActivity(ss, 'SYNC_ALL', 'Sinkronisasi penuh seluruh tabel', 'OK');
    return { status: 'success', message: 'Sinkronisasi 9 tab berhasil' };
  }

  if (action === 'send_wa') {
    const res = sendWhatsAppGateway(payload.wa, ss);
    if (payload.wa && payload.wa.phone) {
      ss.getSheetByName('Log_WA').appendRow([
        'WA-' + new Date().getTime(),
        new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' }),
        payload.wa.studentName || 'Uji Koneksi',
        payload.wa.phone,
        'TEST / RESEND',
        payload.wa.message || '',
        res.statusText
      ]);
    }
    return { status: res.ok ? 'success' : 'error', waStatus: res.statusText };
  }

  return { status: 'unknown_action' };
}

function sendWhatsAppGateway(wa, ss) {
  try {
    // Ambil konfigurasi tersimpan di Pengaturan_Sistem jika payload tidak menyertakan token/endpoint
    const setSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Pengaturan_Sistem');
    const savedSet = {};
    if (setSheet) {
      sheetToObjects(setSheet).forEach(r => { if (r.key) savedSet[r.key] = r.value; });
    }
    const provider = wa.provider || savedSet.waProvider || 'fonnte';
    const endpoint = (wa.endpoint || savedSet.waEndpoint || '').trim();
    const token = (wa.token || savedSet.waToken || '').trim();
    const phoneId = (wa.phoneId || savedSet.waPhoneId || '').trim();

    if (!token || !endpoint) {
      logActivity(ss, 'WA_SKIP', (wa.studentName || wa.phone), 'Token/Endpoint WA belum diisi di Pengaturan');
      return { ok: false, statusText: 'Belum Konfigurasi Token' };
    }

    // Normalisasi nomor tujuan ke format internasional 628xxx
    let targetPhone = String(wa.phone || '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (targetPhone.startsWith('0')) targetPhone = '62' + targetPhone.slice(1);

    let options = { method: 'post', muteHttpExceptions: true };
    let targetUrl = endpoint;

    if (provider === 'meta_cloud') {
      if (phoneId && !endpoint.includes('/messages')) {
        targetUrl = 'https://graph.facebook.com/v20.0/' + phoneId + '/messages';
      }
      options.contentType = 'application/json';
      options.headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token };
      options.payload = JSON.stringify({
        messaging_product: 'whatsapp',
        to: targetPhone,
        type: 'text',
        text: { body: wa.message }
      });
    } else if (provider === 'wablas') {
      options.headers = { 'Authorization': token };
      options.payload = { phone: targetPhone, message: wa.message };
    } else if (provider === 'custom_webhook') {
      options.contentType = 'application/json';
      options.headers = { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token };
      options.payload = JSON.stringify({ phone: targetPhone, message: wa.message, student: wa.studentName || '' });
    } else {
      // Default: Fonnte API
      options.headers = { 'Authorization': token };
      options.payload = { target: targetPhone, message: wa.message, countryCode: '62' };
    }

    const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(targetUrl, options);
    const code = response.getResponseCode();
    const body = response.getContentText();
    const isOk = code >= 200 && code < 300;
    const statusText = isOk ? 'Terkirim Otomatis' : ('Gagal HTTP ' + code);
    logActivity(ss, isOk ? 'WA_TERKIRIM' : 'WA_GAGAL', (wa.studentName || targetPhone) + ' -> ' + targetPhone, 'HTTP ' + code + ' ' + body.slice(0, 80));
    return { ok: isOk, statusText: statusText };
  } catch (e) {
    logActivity(ss, 'WA_ERROR', wa.phone, e.toString());
    return { ok: false, statusText: 'Error Server' };
  }
}

function logActivity(ss, aksi, detail, status) {
  const sh = ss.getSheetByName('Log_Aktivitas');
  if (sh) sh.appendRow([new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID', { timeZone: 'Asia/Jakarta' }), aksi, detail, status]);
}

function initSheets(ss) {
  Object.keys(SHEET_SCHEMAS).forEach(name => {
    let sh = ss.getSheetByName(name);
    if (!sh) {
      sh = ss.insertSheet(name);
      sh.appendRow(SHEET_SCHEMAS[name]);
      sh.getRange(1, 1, 1, SHEET_SCHEMAS[name].length).setFontWeight('bold').setBackground('#0F294A').setFontColor('#FFFFFF');
    }
  });
}

function sheetToObjects(sheet) {
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  if (data.length < 2) return [];
  const headers = data[0];
  return data.slice(1).map(row => {
    const obj = {};
    headers.forEach((h, i) => {
      const val = row[i];
      if (val instanceof Date) {
        if (h === 'jam_masuk' || h === 'jam_pulang') {
          obj[h] = Utilities.formatDate(val, 'Asia/Jakarta', 'HH:mm');
        } else if (h === 'date') {
          obj[h] = Utilities.formatDate(val, 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
        } else {
          obj[h] = Utilities.formatDate(val, 'Asia/Jakarta', 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm');
        }
      } else {
        obj[h] = String(val === null || val === undefined ? '' : val);
      }
    });
    return obj;
  });
}

function upsertRow(sheet, keyCol, rowValues) {
  const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  const keyIdx = data[0].indexOf(keyCol);
  for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++) {
    if (String(data[i][keyIdx]) === String(rowValues[keyIdx])) {
      const rng = sheet.getRange(i + 1, 1, 1, rowValues.length);
      rng.setNumberFormat('@');
      rng.setValues([rowValues]);
      return;
    }
  }
  sheet.appendRow(rowValues);
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  sheet.getRange(lastRow, 1, 1, rowValues.length).setNumberFormat('@');
}

function overwriteSheet(sheet, headers, items) {
  sheet.clearContents();
  sheet.appendRow(headers);
  if (items && items.length > 0) {
    const rows = items.map(item => headers.map(h => item[h] || ''));
    sheet.getRange(2, 1, rows.length, headers.length).setValues(rows);
  }
}

function jsonResponse(obj) {
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(obj)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
